steps.content: Ted walks towards the hidden door in the Public Security Bureau and enters a string of keys on the electric lock to open the intercom.

steps.speaker: Intercom
steps.content: You find saints in churches and drunks in hotels.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: We walk with the ten devils.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's the code for the Public Security Bureau.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Alright, alright, I know he's the informant now. Solve it quickly and get the hell outta here.
No response from the intercom. Ted enters it once again.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You can't stay here for long. That Sinner just now will surely spread the message out. They will be here in no time.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: It's a Sinner organization. The freedom in Syndicate has turned it into a shelter for the Sinners.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: They came here to escape from the authorities, many even formed their own forces, which is now difficult to break and very dangerous.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: The Suspect R you're after is hiding out at the <color=#fb9259>SALVA Hospital</color> on the west of the square—that's a well-known Sinner force.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Since even you are now being tracked down... it's likely that those Sinners have joined forces with each other.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: The situation isn't in your favor. You must return to the Public Security Bureau as soon as possible and make plans after sorting out the intel.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, the ground is shaking. It's a heavy tank... and it's a fleet.
Ted's face suddenly turns pale. Despite receiving no response from the intercom, he can't afford to wait any longer and yanks you to run toward the Public Security Bureau.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: It's them!!
Boom—
The shock leaves you lightheaded. You hear the rumbling from the heavy tanks, gunfire and cannon fire, and the loud crash of concrete walls crumbling.

The dust dissipates, the building has been reduced to rubble. A tall figure appears above your head with feet on the collapsed wall, overlooking the streets. For a moment, you find yourself locking eyes with the person—
It is a Sinner, a very powerful one... Certainly not someone you are strong enough to defeat now.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Come on! The Public Security Bureau has been captured. Run for your life!
Ted's shout pulls you back to reality. Hecate, holding your hand, is pulling you and running into the alley toward the intersection from which you came.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There are enemies ahead!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Break through! Even at the cost of your Sinners!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: This is the last chance. It will be too late if they completely surround the place.
